narrative.overview: The console reads like a kneeboard checklist in a dark cockpit: every fact is a challenge with a dotted leader and a stamped, evidenced response, read top to bottom with attention items first. A near-black blue ground, a deeper-blue rail, bone type on hairline-bordered flat panels. Amber is the single attention voice; green, red and blue only carry state, always beside a glyph and a word. Density is operational: 13px UI, 12px tables, 32px rows, 4/8 spacing, 4px corners. Motion confirms state; the lifecycle beam crossing the air gap is the shell's one ambient moment.
keyCharacteristics: Challenge-and-response lines with dotted leaders and stamps
Amber means a human is needed here
Archivo for UI, Azeret Mono for machine strings
Flat panels on a lightness ladder; shadow only on floating layers

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only attention colour: pending, needs attention, focus, current page, selection. A non-pending primary action is bone.

rules.name: The State Only Rule
rules.body: Green, red and blue appear only where they carry a state, always beside a glyph and a word.

rules.name: The Machine Wrote It Rule
rules.body: Machine strings are Azeret Mono; anything read as a sentence, time or summary is Archivo with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Caps Are Headings Rule
rules.body: Wide-tracked caps label a checklist group, stage or stamp; never an eyebrow above a page or panel title.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: In-flow surfaces are panel plus hairline ring; shadow means the layer floats.

rules.name: The 32 Rule
rules.body: Rows, controls and header cells are 32px tall.

rules.name: The Square Shoulder Rule
rules.body: No in-flow corner exceeds 4px; no pills.

dos: Do express every status as a stamp: glyph, word and state hue together.
Do put the page's primary action on the first pending checklist line, in the attention button.
Do set machine strings in Azeret Mono and human strings in Archivo with tabular numerals.
Do keep in-flow surfaces flat and reserve the float shadow for dialogs, the palette and toasts.
Do keep state transitions at 125 to 250ms on the exponential ease-out.
Do print revoked and retired items in neutral grey.
donts: Don't use amber for decoration, emphasis or a non-pending primary action.
Don't use green, red or blue as accents or brand colour.
Don't add a row of count tiles that repeats the checklist or lifecycle band.
Don't stack a caps label above a page or panel title as an eyebrow.
Don't round in-flow elements past 4px or use pills.
Don't add a second ambient animation inside the shell.
Don't convey state by colour alone.
